## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A seven-fascicle commentary on Kumārajīva's *[Dàzhìdù lùn (T1509)](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0005)*, compiled by Huìyǐng 慧影 in late Northern-and-Southern Dynasties / early Suí time. The opening contents-list shows that the surviving text is partial: fascicles 1, 6, 9, 10, 13, and 14 (plus a final fragment) survive; fascicles 2–5, 7–8, 11–12 are lost. The extant juan cover the *Xùpǐn* (*Mahāprajñāpāramitā* introduction), the thirty-seven *bodhipakṣya-dharmas*, the three *samādhi*s, the four *apramāṇa*s, and selected later sections.

**Abstract**

T1509 is the most extensive Mahāyāna *śāstra* in the Chinese canon; X791 is the principal pre-Tang commentary on it. The work is *chāo*-form (excerpted-and-compiled commentary) drawing on earlier Sānlùn 三論 / Mādhyamika exegetical material; the commentary's doctrinal orientation is broadly compatible with the Six-Dynasties Sānlùn tradition descending through [僧肇](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E8%82%87) Sēngzhào, [僧叡](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E5%8F%A1) Sēngruì, and [僧詮](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E8%A9%AE) Sēngquán. The fragmentary state of transmission has limited the work's modern scholarly attention, but X791 remains the principal pre-Tang commentary on T1509 and a crucial witness for Six-Dynasties Mādhyamika exegesis.
